limitations: Six reference-derived axis perturbations on one development drive; not independent metrology, a complete recovery basin, or multiple independent datasets.
Different initializations can follow different traces; parity is checked within each case only. Cross-case timing summaries mix different search workloads.

CPU comparisons use 1 worker process(es); each owns its arrays/projectors. Parallel timings include contention and are not isolated serial latencies. First invocations are included; no separate warm-up or cold-process guarantee.
Convergence is optimizer termination, not an accuracy acceptance gate. Bootstrap fields are not statistical confidence for these fixed cases.

Case-level limitation: One sequence, one perturbation, 1 invocation(s) per backend. Repetitions measure timing on the same frames, not independent recovery trials. Bootstrap intervals do not establish statistical confidence for this demo.
Case-level limitation: All invocations, including the first, contribute to timing. There is no separate warm-up or cold-process guarantee; lazy compilation and process-wide caches affect latency.
Case-level limitation: Optimizer convergence and CPU/GPU parity do not establish calibration accuracy. Dataset reference is not independent metrology; covariance/observability remain unknown.
Case-level limitation: Only the supplied frozen provider frames are eligible; uniform selection is by position within that provider. Learned depth and frame synchronization can bias the fit.
Case-level limitation: Provider training/evaluation overlap: possible. official non-online-refined checkpoint selected; repository does not publish enough training IDs to exclude drive overlap
Case-level limitation: training/evaluation drive overlap cannot be excluded
Case-level limitation: raw FeatDepth inverse-depth/disparity is retained for D2D histograms
Case-level limitation: metric depth conversion parameters are recorded but not applied

protocol.failure_policy: Keep failed/partial attempts; never substitute a backend or discard a case.
protocol.initial_estimate_policy: Dataset reference plus local Euler rotation +/-0.5 deg and camera-frame translation +/-0.5 m, on x, y, z in that order. Controlled prior; reference is never the optimization target.
protocol.split_policy: Six fixed signed-axis initializations on the same uniform 20-fit/5-holdout provider frames; repetitions are timing observations, not independent recovery trials.
protocol.tuning_policy: All cases/settings fixed before execution; no holdout tuning or filtering.
